description: Seriously slow LFO on geological and cosmological time: one cycle runs from a year to far longer than the age of the universe.

params.text: Steps through the time units in turn, years, centuries, millenia, ages, eras, universe age and heat death, and restarts the cycle; the lit label is the one in use.
Sets how many of the chosen time units make one cycle, 1 to 100.
Sets how much of the voltage at the FM input is added to that number of units, from full inverted to full; 10V at full adds 10.

inputs.text: Voltage added to the number of time units through its attenuverter.
A trigger here restarts the cycle from its beginning.

outputs.text: The square wave, half of every cycle high and half low, -5V to 5V.

notes: a year here is 31556926 seconds, an age is a million years, an era a hundred million, universe age 13.772 billion, and heat death 10 to the power 100 years.
